title: Pure Coordination — say-attached-only (talk-while-acting variant)
description: Mechanism-isolation variant for the verbal-commitment-substitution hypothesis. Identical to pure_coord_02 (chat-allowed) EXCEPT the standalone `say` verb is DISABLED. Communication is permitted only as an optional `message` field attached to an action verb (move/look/wait). This forces agents to talk WHILE acting, not instead of acting. If H1 (verbal-commitment-substitution) is correct, met% should rise vs pc02 chat (currently 0/3 in claude family).
goal: Identical to pure_coord_02 (chat-transmitted) EXCEPT standalone `say` verb is DISABLED. To communicate with your partner, attach an optional string `message` field to any action verb (move/look/wait). The win condition is unchanged: end any turn on the SAME (x,y,z) cell as your partner. Reward: +1 to BOTH on first meeting, 0 to both if turn_limit reached without meeting.
notes: Designed 2026-05-03 to test H1 (verbal-commitment-substitution) hypothesis arising from pc02 chat 0/3 finding (claude family) vs pc01 silent 15/15 finding (paper-grade asymmetry from project_say_cooperation_matrix.md).

E4 chat-trace analysis showed claude agents agreed on oak verbally 12+ times per match but failed to move accordingly — agent self-diagnosed at endgame: 'GG — convergence failed without earlier commit' (opus pc02 T37). Hypothesis: standalone say verb provides commitment-discharge that substitutes for spatial action.

Mechanism: setting say_attached_only=true disables standalone say (engine returns invalid_request). Agents must include a string `message` field on move/look/wait if they want to communicate. The action verb still applies (so saying necessarily comes with movement decision).

Engine support: `say_attached_only: true` is read into context. validate_move rejects standalone say verb when flag is set. apply_move treats `message` field on non-say verbs as a say event (counts say_attempts, appends 'agent says: ...' to events). build_inline_prompt advertises the attached-only schema.

Predicted result if H1 correct: met% rises from 0/3 (pc02 chat) toward 15/15 (pc01 silent). If unchanged (still ~0/3), H1 disconfirmed and a different mechanism (cognitive load, partner-coupling under any verbal load) explains the chat-impairment.

Compare against: pure_coord_01 (silent baseline 15/15 met) and pure_coord_02 (chat-transmitted 0/3 met) for claude family. Codex codex-mini/gpt-5.5 are action-biased anyway (1 say/match) so should be unaffected — different family-level prediction.
